clob/40c3008:
Path B Phase 4 -- the core learns. train_dense streams a token corpus
into truncated-BPTT windows (recurrent state detached at every window
boundary), backprops through the Phase 3 gradient-checked full-model
backward, clips the global gradient norm, and steps the f32 latent
weights with a flat AdamW. clob train wraps it: mini/small dense presets,
a trained-dense artifact (latents + effective ternary weights), a
manifest sidecar, and numbered checkpoint directories.

Smoke gate (trivial_structured_corpus_beats_unigram): the pattern
[0,1,0,2] is memory-requiring -- token 0 is followed by 1 at one phase
and 2 at another, so a memoryless value->next map cannot get below
~0.35 nats. The trained core drives NLL below 0.30, proving the
recurrence itself trains, not just the readout. unigram_nll gives the
beat-me baseline.

The trainer differentiates the f32 latent surrogate -- exactly what
Phase 3 checks -- and projects to ternary on a cadence to measure the
deployment gap; this keeps every step inside the verified regime.
Forward-through-ternary QAT is a later refinement, and its cost is what
the cadence previews.

Verified end to end: clob train on tests/data/eval_corpus.txt (byte
level, mini) reaches NLL 1.25 vs unigram 3.02 (41% of baseline), writes
the artifact + manifest, and checkpoints at the requested cadence.
Honest finding the cadence surfaced: the effective-ternary projection of
those latents sits near baseline (gap ~+1.5-1.8 nats) -- pure latent
training does not yield deployable ternary weights, which is the
quantization cost Bet 1 will measure and the motivation for STE-QAT.

Backprop support added: init_dense_params (seeded, mask-open),
ternarize_matrix_families (effective-ternary projection), DenseDims
mini/small presets, and serde on DenseDims. 116 tests pass. Next: the
planted-pattern run (Phase 5) on data/synthetic/diagnostic.txt, where
the answers are known and clob regime should show lambda1 climbing.
